title: Jobs Miss Sparks A Rally, But Yields Won't Back Down
speaker: Gareth Soloway

macro_themes.view: 10-year at 5.28%, at the 2007 pivot high; a break above likely triggers equity selling and potential financial crisis.
NFP 29K vs 89K, takes pressure off Fed hiking in Oct/Dec; good for markets as long as not negative.
Expects push to get oil lower into the midterms; France reserve release helping.
Prefers equal weight/beaten-down names (Nike, Clorox) over tech at ATH that may take a breather.

calls.condition: Bullish while above his neutral line; a 10-year yield break above the 2007 high would likely cause selling.
calls.reason: S&P resilient despite 5.3% yields, ~1% off ATH and above his neutral line.
calls.quote: We're above my neutral line, which means I'm we're in the bullish zone. I remain bullish into next week

calls.reason: Nasdaq-100 first ATH since June; but says tech at highs may take a breather.
calls.quote: The tech stocks, the ones that are at all-time highs, they may take a breather

calls.condition: If yields break above the 2007 pivot high, markets likely sell.
calls.reason: 10-year at major pivotal resistance from 2007 high; intraday low 5.15%.
calls.quote: yields again, go into next week right at this massive resistance level. A break above this, the market's likely do sell

calls.condition: Only if NVDA rallies to the upper trend line ~255+; won't short the current double top.
calls.reason: History of Nvidia reversing at the ascending trend line; double top at ATH not a short by itself.
calls.quote: That is where I would take the short on Nvidia up here, which on the charts would be around 255 or higher

calls.condition: If $89 support breaks, oil falls quickly to ~$78-79.
calls.reason: Trend-line support at $89; historically oil falls into midterms as administrations push gas lower.
calls.quote: I actually think that's going to end up happening in the next month going into the midterms

calls.reason: Capitulation volume (120M shares) after atrocious earnings, tagged major weekly support ~32.50 and reversed; sees a major pivot low.
calls.quote: I think today we're going to look back and say that was the low on Nike

calls.condition: If the long-term trend line breaks, test 3945; below that, opens to ~3500.
calls.reason: Gold hammering long-term trend line, possible bear flag after this week's drop; rising yields hurt gold.
calls.quote: you have to be on high alert with the metals based on the price action

calls.condition: If ascending trend line breaks, go to 55; if that breaks, $50 or below.
calls.reason: Same setup as gold, sitting on ascending trend line.
calls.quote: If this breaks, we go down to 55. If that breaks, we're headed down to the $50 or sub $50 level on silver

calls.condition: Break above 3.30 for a bigger breakout.
calls.reason: Natural gas reversed sharply; he is long and slightly green; 3.30 is the breakout level.
calls.quote: I still remain bullish on nat gas

notes: Friday jobs-report day (Oct 2, 2026); recorded minutes before the close. NG ticker used for natural gas (not in canonical list); '330' read as $3.30. CL bearish target is midpoint of 78-79. Clorox mentioned only in passing (skipped).
